public.text: The process correctly treats product master-data management as an ongoing programme, but it does not explicitly include source onboarding, data cleansing, deduplication, identifier assignment, governance, or transition from local catalogues.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a staged implementation method covering source inventory, data profiling, canonical modelling, identifier policy, matching, cleansing, source onboarding, publication, synchronisation, and retirement of duplicate lists.
